rule_for_sr: MANDATORY: any change in bot.py affecting module structure (adding function, moving block, changing dependencies) — update index.json and the corresponding module file in modules/. The index is a living document, not an archive.

new_sr_start_here: 2. Code lives in honeycombs/fruits/gentle_companion/ — config.py, store.py, github_api.py, etc.
3. Read sr_engine section for SR prompts and free_conversation
4. Open other module files as needed
before_patching: Determine which module the changed block belongs to
Check module dependencies (depends_on in index.json dependency_graph)
After patch update last_updated in index.json
ALWAYS request actual module files before patching — never use cached/uploaded versions

Block 3 ALWAYS includes full deploy: py patcher.py; Remove-Item patcher.py; git add <files>; git commit -m '<msg>'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push; ssh root@91.99.149.226 'cd /opt/mandala && git pull && systemctl restart mandala-bot && journalctl -u mandala-bot -n 5 --no-pager'

changelog.summary: Fixed 15 build-breaking issues across 5 files (github_api.py, handlers/system.py, handlers/tasks.py, handlers/features.py, sr_conversation.py), introduced by an incomplete 2026-07-19 refactor to _replace_menu(). build.py had been failing silently since 2026-07-19 — production ran the 2026-07-11 build the whole time. Root causes: orphaned try/except tails, literal newlines inside string literals, lost quote characters, one control-byte corruption, and lost `sent =` captures that broke downstream message-id tracking. Verified via ast.parse + py_compile + full build.py assembly, deployed and confirmed healthy via /health and journalctl.
changelog.also_found: index.json itself was out of sync: duplicate/conflicting bot_version_analyzed key, stale module sizes, undocumented 2026-07-19 functionality (_replace_menu, run_auto_cleanup, _delete_gardener, _remove_from_whitelist). Corrected in this same update per sync_onboarding_and_source rule.

changes: Фикс сборки (15 поломок в 5 модулях, восстановлена сборка build.py)
Новая система проактивных сообщений (вехи 1/3/7/15/30/31, реальный DELETE через GitHub API)
Отключение лимитов (ENFORCE_LIMITS = False, 20 точек проверки обёрнуты)
Исправлен баг с перепутанными hard/soft лимитами в _create_task_atomic
TZ-ARCHITECT-INTEGRATION-003: Добавлена синхронизация данных Архитектора (ID 224736062) в profile_deep.json.
github_api.py: добавлена функция _sync_architect_data() — обновляет section_B и synthesis_layer_2.
short_responses: Добавлено правило краткости в боевой SR_CORE_PROMPT (sr_prompts.py).
Удалён подтверждённо мёртвый код SR_INTENT_MAP (~13 КБ).
Sphere resonance decay redesign: полная переработка падения резонанса — по-сферная логика с порогами 3/6/7 дней, -2%/день с 8-го дня, пол 0%.
Universal activity tracking: добавлена TrackInteractionMiddleware — трекинг активности садовника через любые каналы (чат, команды, кнопки).
Хотфикс NameError в _build_user_context_msg: _ws_ctx → workspace (исправлена ошибка, уронившая обработку текстовых сообщений).
